_doc: User-editable TDX -> cSurvey symbol mapping, consumed by preprocess_tdx_csx.py.
to SEE every point glyph next to its app (Italian) name and enum identity.
{"to": "<name>"}    rename; target must resolve to a SignEnum member
after dashes are stripped (e.g. soda-straw -> SodaStraw),
or be 'label'. Pick glyph-backed targets from the catalog.
{"label": "<text>"} convert to a text label with that text.
{"leave": true}      explicitly keep as-is (suppresses the warning).
lines: same, but 'to' targets are ONLY the fixed import vocabulary
(see catalog bottom table): wall, wall:presumed, presumed, border,
overhang, pit, chimney, slope, floor-meander, ceiling-meander,
areas: 'to' targets: water, sand, clay, debris, blocks, pebbles.
